title: 第400章 番外：权臣在现代（六）
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我们公司那个渣男，就是我上次跟你们提起的小孙，昨天晚上九点多被人在小区外捅了，身上中了五刀，全都避开要害……”

听着祝卿安的话，林夕也抬起了头，“这么吓人吗？谁干的？”

祝卿安道：“监控只拍到了那个人的身材，穿着连帽风衣，脸都被帽子和口罩挡完了，小孙那时喝醉了，被抢救后只说对方应该是个男的，短头发，眼睛很凶。”

宋雲初拿起了桌上的柠檬水，道了一句：“真是倒霉。”

她把长发用隐形发网兜住了，戴的短款假发，果然很明智。

祝卿安继续翻群里的聊天记录，“不对，不止五刀，脸上还有两刀，伤口有十几厘米长，那个人在小孙脸上打了个叉……”

“是个狠人啊。”林夕感慨道，“渣男挨这么多下，肯定得痛得死去活来，这真是一份能让我写进书里的好素材。话说……他以后会不会失业？”

“我们主要卖的是脸部产品，直播的时候会教粉丝护肤和上妆的步骤，每场直播都要上妆卸妆好几次，他的脸受伤那么严重，就算出院了，也很长时间不能碰产品，几个月不开播，粉丝就会忘记他的，毕竟互联网到处是帅哥。”

祝卿安分析道，“虽然他是老板的亲戚，但他如果不能给公司带来收益，最后也只能走人。”

这事要是放在别人身上，她一定会产生几分同情，可发生在小孙身上，她只觉得他活该。

这人做的恶心事太多了，她只恨不得他赶紧滚出公司。

昨夜他被人捅进医院，大概是现世报吧。

三人点的菜很快都上齐了，祝卿安边吃边问宋雲初，“你上周没去你小姨那里，明天是不是要去了？”

“嗯。”宋雲初应道，“小姨刚才给我发消息了，让我明天中午去她那里吃饭。”

“明天我和朋友约了做美甲，是在离你小姨那边不远的一个广场，我明天上午顺便把你捎过去吧。”

“好啊。”

第二日上午，宋雲初坐上了祝卿安的车，来到了小姨所在的小区外。

“我去找我朋友了，你要回去的时候跟我发个消息。”

“嗯，我买了一些盒子蛋糕，你拿一袋去，跟你朋友分着吃。”

望着宋雲初递来的蛋糕，祝卿安两眼放光地伸手接下。

宋雲初提着其他礼品下了车，走向了前方的小区。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"The scumbag in our company is the Xiao Sun I mentioned to you last time. He was stabbed outside the community at around nine o'clock last night. He was stabbed five times, all of them avoiding his vitals..."

Listening to Zhu Qing'an's words, Lin Xi also raised her head, "Is it so scary? Who did it?"

Zhu Qing'an said: "The surveillance only captured the figure of the man. He was wearing a hooded windbreaker, and his face was completely blocked by the hat and mask. Xiao Sun was drunk at the time. After being rescued, he only said that the man should be a man with short hair and fierce eyes."

Song Yunchu picked up the lemonade on the table and said, "What bad luck."

She covered her long hair with an invisible hairnet and wore a short wig, which was really smart.

Zhu Qingan continued to look through the chat history in the group, "No, there were more than five stabs, there were two stabs on the face. The wounds were more than ten centimeters long. That person put a cross on Xiao Sun's face..."

"He is a ruthless man." Lin Xi sighed with emotion, "If this scumbag is beaten so many times, he will definitely be in pain to death. This is really good material for me to write in a book. By the way...will he be unemployed in the future?"

"We mainly sell facial products. During the live broadcast, we will teach fans the steps of skin care and makeup. Every live broadcast has to apply and remove makeup several times. His face was so seriously injured that even if he is discharged from the hospital, he will not be able to touch the products for a long time. If he does not go on air for a few months, fans will forget about him. After all, the Internet is full of handsome guys."

Zhu Qingan analyzed, "Although he is a relative of the boss, if he cannot bring benefits to the company, he will have no choice but to leave in the end."

If this happened to others, she would definitely feel some sympathy, but when it happened to Xiao Sun, she just felt that he deserved it.

This man had done too many disgusting things, and she just wanted him to get out of the company as soon as possible.

He was stabbed into the hospital last night, probably as retribution in this world.

The dishes ordered by the three of them were all served quickly. While eating, Zhu Qingan asked Song Yunchu, "You didn't go to your aunt's place last week, are you going to go there tomorrow?"

"Yes." Song Yunchu responded, "My aunt just sent me a message and asked me to go to her place for dinner at noon tomorrow."

"Tomorrow I have an appointment with a friend to get a manicure. It will be in a square not far from your aunt. I will take you there by the way tomorrow morning."

"Okay."

On the morning of the next day, Song Yunchu got into Zhu Qingan's car and arrived outside the community where his aunt was.

"I'm going to find my friend. Send me a message when you go back."

"Well, I bought some boxes of cakes. You can take a bag and share it with your friends."

Looking at the cake handed over by Song Yunchu, Zhu Qingan reached out to take it with gleaming eyes.

Song Yunchu got out of the car with other gifts and walked towards the community ahead.
